objective: sum pixel U + gamma sum block U + sibling/4 sum scale-table costs + parent sum label-mismatch
block_meaning: soft dominant class; no exact majority requirement
sibling_graph: 4-connected spatial adjacency at every level, including adjacent blocks with different immediate parents
prior: Previously user-specified revised D5 biological preference matrix retained; separately learned and normalized six-class table per scale; .8 data/.2 prior.
solver: bidirectional deterministic ICM; strict decreases, local optimum only
init: identical in both versions: raw pixel argmax and averaged-probability block argmax
evaluation: 100 fixed patches; pooled five-biological-class mIoU; six-class and per-class metrics also reported
trigger: Run version 2 if V1 pooled biological mIoU does not exceed raw, or any patch biological mIoU worsens.
